_comment: Curated metadata for Super Nintendo (SNES) entries. The compressed .zip sets in the inventory follow No-Intro naming, where tags such as (USA), (Japan), (Europe), (Rev 1), (Proto) and (Beta) describe the dump. Those tags are parsed by the build script and are not repeated here.

snes/ActRaiser (USA).zip.title: ActRaiser
snes/ActRaiser (USA).zip.desc: A hybrid game in which a deity clears action stages as a swordsman and then rebuilds a simulated world in a top-down city-building phase.
snes/ActRaiser (USA).zip.history: Quintet's debut title, with a celebrated orchestral score by Yuzo Koshiro.

snes/ActRaiser (USA) (Arcade).zip.title: ActRaiser
snes/ActRaiser (USA) (Arcade).zip.desc: An alternate release of ActRaiser with the world-building phase simplified for quicker play.

snes/ActRaiser 2 (USA).zip.title: ActRaiser 2
snes/ActRaiser 2 (USA).zip.desc: A sequel that drops the simulation layer and concentrates on side-scrolling combat with a winged hero.

snes/Addams Family, The (USA).zip.title: The Addams Family
snes/Addams Family, The (USA).zip.desc: A large platform adventure in which Gomez searches the family mansion for the missing members of his household.

snes/Addams Family, The (USA) (Arcade).z.title: The Addams Family
snes/Addams Family, The (USA) (Arcade).z.desc: An alternate release of The Addams Family with adjusted level design.

snes/Addams Family Values (USA) (En,Fr,D.title: Addams Family Values
snes/Addams Family Values (USA) (En,Fr,D.desc: A sequel based on the second film, with an action-RPG structure and multiple playable characters.

snes/Alien 3 (USA).zip.title: Alien 3
snes/Alien 3 (USA).zip.desc: A mission-based adaptation of the third film, with Ripley completing objectives on a prison planet in a time limit.

snes/Alien vs Predator (USA).zip.title: Alien vs Predator
snes/Alien vs Predator (USA).zip.desc: A one-on-one fighting game based on the crossover franchise, with humans, aliens and predators in the roster.

snes/Arcana (USA).zip.title: Arcana
snes/Arcana (USA).zip.desc: A first-person dungeon-crawling RPG with card-based character summoning and a large tower to explore.

snes/Arkanoid - Doh It Again (USA).zip.title: Arkanoid: Doh It Again
snes/Arkanoid - Doh It Again (USA).zip.desc: A Super Nintendo Arkanoid with new power-ups, boss battles and a level editor.

snes/Art of Fighting (USA).zip.title: Art of Fighting
snes/Art of Fighting (USA).zip.desc: A one-on-one fighter with oversized sprites and a spirit gauge that limits special moves.

snes/Axelay (USA).zip.title: Axelay
snes/Axelay (USA).zip.desc: A shooter that alternates between horizontal and pseudo-3D vertical stages, with a configurable weapon system.

snes/Batman Returns (USA).zip.title: Batman Returns
snes/Batman Returns (USA).zip.desc: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up based on the film, with Batman fighting through Gotham's streets and rooftops.

snes/Battletoads in Battlemaniacs (USA)..title: Battletoads in Battlemaniacs
snes/Battletoads in Battlemaniacs (USA)..desc: A tough side-scrolling brawler with speeder-bike sequences and the series' trademark difficulty.

snes/Battletoads-Double Dragon (USA).zip.title: Battletoads-Double Dragon
snes/Battletoads-Double Dragon (USA).zip.desc: A crossover brawler teaming the Battletoads with Billy and Jimmy Lee against the Dark Queen and Shadow Boss.

snes/BioMetal (USA).zip.title: BioMetal
snes/BioMetal (USA).zip.desc: A horizontal shooter with a rotating shield system and a techno soundtrack by 2 Unlimited.

snes/Blackthorne (USA).zip.title: Blackthorne
snes/Blackthorne (USA).zip.desc: A cinematic platformer in which an exiled prince returns to free his people, using a shotgun and cover-based movement.

snes/Breath of Fire (USA).zip.title: Breath of Fire
snes/Breath of Fire (USA).zip.desc: The first Breath of Fire, following Ryu and his companions on a quest involving dragon transformations and the Dark Dragon clan.

snes/Breath of Fire II (USA).zip.title: Breath of Fire II
snes/Breath of Fire II (USA).zip.desc: A larger sequel with town-building, a shaman fusion system and a story set generations after the first game.

snes/Brawl Brothers (USA).zip.title: Brawl Brothers
snes/Brawl Brothers (USA).zip.desc: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up and the second entry in Jaleco's Rushing Beat series, with branching routes.

snes/Bubsy in - Claws Encounters of the.title: Bubsy in Claws Encounters of the Furred Kind
snes/Bubsy in - Claws Encounters of the.desc: A fast platformer starring a bobcat who collects yarn and glides through colourful stages.

snes/Bust-A-Move (USA).zip.title: Bust-A-Move
snes/Bust-A-Move (USA).zip.desc: The bubble-popping puzzle game (Puzzle Bobble), where matching three colours clears clusters from the ceiling.

snes/Captain America and the Avengers (U.title: Captain America and the Avengers
snes/Captain America and the Avengers (U.desc: A side-scrolling brawler with four playable Marvel heroes and a chain of supervillain bosses.

snes/Captain Commando (USA).zip.title: Captain Commando
snes/Captain Commando (USA).zip.desc: A futuristic beat-'em-up with four selectable heroes and rideable mechs.

snes/Castlevania - Dracula X (USA).zip.title: Castlevania: Dracula X
snes/Castlevania - Dracula X (USA).zip.desc: A Super Nintendo reworking of Rondo of Blood, with Richter Belmont fighting through Dracula's castle to save Annette and Maria.

snes/Clay Fighter (USA).zip.title: Clay Fighter
snes/Clay Fighter (USA).zip.desc: A comedy fighting game with claymation-style characters and exaggerated special moves.

snes/Clay Fighter 2 - Judgment Clay (USA.title: Clay Fighter 2: Judgment Clay
snes/Clay Fighter 2 - Judgment Clay (USA.desc: The sequel to Clay Fighter, adding characters, stages and a more elaborate combo system.

snes/Contra IV - The Alien Wars (USA) (B.title: Contra IV: The Alien Wars
snes/Contra IV - The Alien Wars (USA) (B.desc: A beta build of the game released outside Japan as Contra III: The Alien Wars, preserved in the collection.

snes/Darius Twin (USA).zip.title: Darius Twin
snes/Darius Twin (USA).zip.desc: A two-player horizontal shooter with a branching stage map and the series' mechanical fish bosses.

snes/Demon's Crest (USA).zip.title: Demon's Crest
snes/Demon's Crest (USA).zip.desc: A dark spin-off of Ghosts'n Goblins in which the demon Firebrand explores a non-linear world and gains new forms.

snes/D-Force (USA).zip.title: D-Force
snes/D-Force (USA).zip.desc: A vertically scrolling helicopter shooter with a rotating rotor shield and a mode-7 style presentation.

snes/Cool Spot (USA).zip.title: Cool Spot
snes/Cool Spot (USA).zip.desc: A platformer starring the 7 Up mascot, with tight jumps and hidden bonus stages.

snes/Choplifter III - Rescue-Survive (US.title: Choplifter III: Rescue-Survive
snes/Choplifter III - Rescue-Survive (US.desc: A helicopter rescue game with side-scrolling and top-down stages and a variety of rescue objectives.

snes/Cybernator (USA).zip.title: Cybernator
snes/Cybernator (USA).zip.desc: A mech action game (Assault Suits Valken in Japan) with weighty movement, boost jumps and a branching mission structure.

snes/Cliffhanger (USA).zip.title: Cliffhanger
snes/Cliffhanger (USA).zip.desc: A side-scrolling action game based on the film, mixing brawling and skiing sequences.

snes/Congo's Caper (USA).zip.title: Congo's Caper
snes/Congo's Caper (USA).zip.desc: A colourful platformer in which a young ape rescues his girlfriend from a witch doctor, with two-player co-op.

snes/Cutthroat Island (USA).zip.title: Cutthroat Island
snes/Cutthroat Island (USA).zip.desc: A film tie-in with side-scrolling brawling, swordplay and sailing sections.

snes/Aladdin.sfc.title: Aladdin
snes/Aladdin.sfc.desc: The Super Nintendo Aladdin, a Disney-licensed platformer with cape-gliding and a Genie bonus stage.

snes/Chrono Trigger.sfc.title: Chrono Trigger
snes/Chrono Trigger.sfc.desc: A time-travelling RPG in which a party changes history across eras, with combo techniques and multiple endings.
snes/Chrono Trigger.sfc.history: Developed by a 'dream team' including Hironobu Sakaguchi, Yuji Horii and Akira Toriyama, Chrono Trigger is regularly cited among the greatest role-playing games ever made.

snes/Contra III - The Alien Wars.smc.title: Contra III: The Alien Wars
snes/Contra III - The Alien Wars.smc.desc: A run-and-gun shooter with two-player co-op, rotating Mode 7 stages and a punishing difficulty.

snes/EarthBound.sfc.title: EarthBound
snes/EarthBound.sfc.desc: A modern-day RPG in which Ness and his friends travel suburbia and beyond to stop Giygas, mixing humour with a surprisingly dark story.
snes/EarthBound.sfc.history: Released in Japan as Mother 2, EarthBound was a commercial disappointment in the West but became a cult classic and a major influence on later indie RPGs.

snes/Final Fantasy III.sfc.title: Final Fantasy III
snes/Final Fantasy III.sfc.desc: The North American release of Final Fantasy VI, an ensemble RPG with fourteen playable characters and a world-ending mid-game twist.
snes/Final Fantasy III.sfc.notes: The collection file uses the original North American title, Final Fantasy III. The game is known in Japan as Final Fantasy VI.

snes/F-Zero.sfc.title: F-Zero
snes/F-Zero.sfc.desc: A futuristic racing game built on Mode 7 scaling, with high-speed tracks and no multiplayer mode.
snes/F-Zero.sfc.history: A launch title for the Super Nintendo that demonstrated the console's Mode 7 background rotation and scaling.

snes/Killer Instinct.sfc.title: Killer Instinct
snes/Killer Instinct.sfc.desc: A combo-heavy arcade fighter with pre-rendered graphics and an announcer famous for escalating combo call-outs.

snes/Kirby Super Star.sfc.title: Kirby Super Star
snes/Kirby Super Star.sfc.desc: A compilation of eight Kirby games with copy abilities, helper characters and two-player co-op.

snes/Mortal Kombat.sfc.title: Mortal Kombat
snes/Mortal Kombat.sfc.desc: The Super Nintendo port of the controversial arcade fighter, with digitised fighters, Fatalities and a tournament ladder.
snes/Mortal Kombat.sfc.gameplay: Two fighters trade strikes, blocks and special moves across a best-of-three round system. Input codes trigger Fatalities after the final hit.
snes/Mortal Kombat.sfc.history: The SNES version is famous for replacing the arcade's blood with 'sweat' to satisfy Nintendo's content guidelines, while the Mega Drive release kept the gore.

snes/Mortal Kombat II (Rev A).sfc.title: Mortal Kombat II
snes/Mortal Kombat II (Rev A).sfc.desc: A faster, gorier sequel with new characters, stage fatalities, Babalities and Friendships.
snes/Mortal Kombat II (Rev A).sfc.notes: The filename tag (Rev A) identifies a revision A cartridge dump.

snes/Pilotwings.smc.title: Pilotwings
snes/Pilotwings.smc.desc: A flight training game with light plane, skydiving and rocket-belt events, using Mode 7 for its pseudo-3D landscapes.

snes/Secret of Mana.sfc.title: Secret of Mana
snes/Secret of Mana.sfc.desc: An action RPG with real-time combat, a charge-attack weapon system and three-player co-operative play.
snes/Secret of Mana.sfc.history: Originally planned for the SNES CD add-on, Secret of Mana was reworked into a cartridge release and became one of the platform's most beloved RPGs.

snes/smw_mariointhevoid.smc.title: Super Mario World: Mario in the Void
snes/smw_mariointhevoid.smc.desc: A fan-made Super Mario World ROM hack present in the collection under the filename smw_mariointhevoid.smc. Its release details are not verified.
snes/smw_mariointhevoid.smc.notes: This is a community ROM hack, not an officially released game. Original Super Mario World code and assets belong to Nintendo.

snes/Street Fighter II.title: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
snes/Street Fighter II.desc: The Super Nintendo conversion of Capcom's fighting-game landmark, with all eight World Warriors and the four bosses.
snes/Street Fighter II.notes: The inventory lists this as a folder; the files inside it are not itemised in the source listing.

snes/Super Bomberman 2.sfc.title: Super Bomberman 2
snes/Super Bomberman 2.sfc.desc: A maze-based bomberman sequel with a story mode and four-player battle mode using the multitap.

snes/Super Mario Kart.sfc.title: Super Mario Kart
snes/Super Mario Kart.sfc.desc: The first Mario Kart, using Mode 7 tracks, item boxes and split-screen two-player races.

snes/Super Mario World.sfc.title: Super Mario World
snes/Super Mario World.sfc.desc: Mario and Yoshi explore Dinosaur Land across 96 exits, with Cape Feather flight and secret routes.
snes/Super Mario World.sfc.history: The Super Nintendo launch title and the best-selling game on the platform, directed by Takashi Tezuka.

snes/Super Star Wars - The Empire Strike.title: Super Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
snes/Super Star Wars - The Empire Strike.desc: A run-and-gun adaptation of the film, with Hoth, Dagobah and Cloud City stages and Mode 7 vehicle sections.

snes/Tecmo Super Bowl.title: Tecmo Super Bowl
snes/Tecmo Super Bowl.desc: The Super Nintendo entry in Tecmo's football series, with NFL teams and a full season mode.
snes/Tecmo Super Bowl.notes: The inventory lists this as a folder; the files inside it are not itemised in the source listing.

snes/Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV - T.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV: Turtles in Time
snes/Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles IV - T.desc: A time-travelling beat-'em-up with two-player co-op, throwing enemies at the screen and a Mode 7 surfing stage.

snes/Top Gear 2.sfc.title: Top Gear 2
snes/Top Gear 2.sfc.desc: A racing game with a world tour, car upgrades and a split-screen two-player mode.

snes/Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3.sfc.title: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3
snes/Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3.sfc.desc: An expanded Mortal Kombat 3 with more characters, stages and hidden match types.

snes/Zombies Ate My Neighbors.sfc.title: Zombies Ate My Neighbors
snes/Zombies Ate My Neighbors.sfc.desc: A two-player monster-movie spoof in which Zeke and Julie rescue neighbours from zombies, aliens and giant babies.
